WITH store_sales_set AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
web_sales_set AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
catalog_sales_set AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3 
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_sales_set WHERE ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_sales_set WHERE ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_sales_set WHERE cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
